about: Every OBP-API call Opey makes from its own code: verb, path (OBP placeholders in capitals), the source file and the text that makes the call (needles), and the response fields the code reads. Paths built from OBP_API_VERSION are recorded with the version .env.example sets. Not listed: the obp_requests tool of src/client/obp_client.py and the OBP-MCP tools, whose method and path the model chooses at run time. test/test_obp_contract.py checks this list against the source and against snapshot.json, which obp-api-contract/snapshot.py writes from an OBP-API's resource docs.

calls.note: Checks a Consent-Id (OBPConsentAuth) or a bearer token (OBPBearerAuth); src/service/routers/session.py reads user_id from the answer.
Only the status code is checked: below 500 means OBP-API is up.
